Date. November 24, 1936.

Subject Dinner Party given by Vice-Admiral K. Oikawa at the Japanese Club
on November 23, 1936.

Made by D.S. Pitts. Forwarded by J. L. G.

A dinner party at the Japanese Club, Boone Road, was
given by Vice-Admiral K. Oikawa, Commander-in-Chief of the
Japanese Third Fleet in Chinese Waters, who is being transferred
shortly to the Naval General Staff Office in Japan, at 6.30 p.m.
November 23, 1936. The function lasted until 8.40 p.m. and
some 330 guests, including prominent Japanese residents, attended.

Personnel of Hongkew Station, members of the Special
Branch, and representatives of the Japanese Consular Police
and Naval Landing Party carried out observation duties in the
vicinity of the Club during the period of the function.

Nothing of an untoward nature occurred.

The following attended from the Special Branch:
D.S.S. Pitts, Lockwood, Kamashita.

D.C. (Special Branch).

（印：B 1936）

Da. Pitts.
D. S.

MOVEMENTS OF JAPANESE WARSHIPS.

A Korean dancing partner named

VICE-ADMIRAL HYAKUTAKE AND REAR-ADMIRAL SUGISAKA LEAVING SHANGHAI TO-DAY

Vice-Admiral Hyakutake, who handed over the command of the Third Fleet to Vice-Admiral Oikawa yesterday, and Rear-Admiral Sugisaka, formerly commander of the IIth Squadron, will leave here for Japan on the S. S. Nagasaki Maru.

MASS ARREST OF JAPANESE ON A CHARGE OF LESA-MAJESTY IN JAPAN

A Dentsu telegram from Tokyo dated December 8 reports that the Japanese authorities arrested several hundreds Japanese who are the followers of the Omoto religion for having committed lesa-majesty against the Japanese Emperor. There are about one million believers of that religion in Japan.

JAPANESE AUTHORITIES REJECT SILVER SMUGGLERS' PETITION.

At 11 a.m. yesterday about one hundred Japanese silver smugglers visited the Japanese Consular Police and petitioned for the removal of the suppression on silver dollar smuggling, but it was rejected by the authorities who advised them to go back to Japan as quickly as possible. It is further reported that there are about 1,000 Japanese silver dollar smugglers who have come here from Japan recently, each of whom is hoarding over one thousand silver dollars.

S. B. D.
S. 1, Special Branch,
REPORT
Date December 4, 1935.

Subject Movements of Japanese Admirals.

Made by Umemoto. Forwarded by

Vice-Admiral Oikawa, newly appointed Commander-in-Chief
of the Japanese Third Fleet, will arrive in Shanghai from
Japan on board the s.s. "Nagasaki Maru", which will berth at
the N.Y.K. wayside wharf, at about 3 p.m. December 8. Following
disembarkation from the vessel the Admiral will proceed by
motor-car along Yangtszepoo Road to the cruiser "Idzumo",
which is berthed at the D.K.R. Whangpoo Wharf, to take over
office from Vice-Admiral Hyakutake.

Upon being relieved, Vice-Admiral Hyakutake will leave
the flagship and proceed to the Hoyo Hotel, North Haining Road,
by motor-car, by way of Yangtszepoo, Broadway, Boone, Woosung,
Haining and North Haining Roads.

At about 3 a.m. December 9, the Admiral will leave the
hotel and proceed by motor-car to the N.Y.K. Wayside Wharf,
taking the same route, and board the s.s. "Nagasaki Maru",
which will sail for Japan at 9 a.m. on the same date.

Commander Ohsugi, Senior Staff Officer of the Japanese
Naval Landing Party, has requested that a Municipal Police
motor-cycle escort be provided for these two Admirals during
their official movements on December 8 and 9. It was also
learned from this officer that a guard of honour consisting
some 80 officers and men from the Japanese Naval Landing Party
will form up in front of the Hoyo Hotel on the occasion of
the arrival of Vice-Admiral Hyakutake at the hotel on
December 8 and again on December 9 when he leaves for the
s.s. "Nagasaki Maru".

Rear-Admiral Hibino, newly appointed Commander of the
11th Squadron, will arrive by the s.s. "Nagasaki Maru" on
December 8.

日期：1935年12月4日。

主题：日本海军上将的动向。

由梅本 (Umemoto) 撰写。转呈者

新任日本第三舰队司令长官及川 (Oikawa) 海军中将，将于12月8日下午3时左右，乘坐“长崎丸”号轮船 (s.s. "Nagasaki Maru") 从日本抵达上海，该船将停靠在日清汽船公司 (N.Y.K.) 的旁侧码头 (wayside wharf)。下船后，该海军中将将乘汽车沿杨树浦路前往停泊在大阪商船会社 (D.K.R.) 黄浦码头的“出云”号巡洋舰 (cruiser "Idzumo")，从百武 (Hyakutake) 海军中将手中接任职务。

卸任后，百武海军中将将离开旗舰，乘汽车经杨树浦路、百老汇路 (Broadway)、蓬路 (Boone)、吴淞路 (Woosung)、海宁路和北海宁路，前往位于北海宁路的报知酒店 (Hoyo Hotel)。

12月9日凌晨3时左右，该海军中将将离开酒店，沿原路乘汽车前往日清汽船公司旁侧码头，登上“长崎丸”号轮船，该船将于当日上午9时启航前往日本。

日本海军陆战队高级参谋官大杉 (Ohsugi) 少佐请求，在12月8日和9日这两位海军上将进行公务活动期间，由工部局警务处提供摩托车护卫。另从该军官处获悉，在12月8日百武海军中将抵达酒店以及12月9日他离开前往“长崎丸”号轮船时，将由约80名日本海军陆战队官兵组成仪仗队，在报知酒店前列队。

新任第11战队司令官日比野 (Hibino) 海军少将，将于12月8日乘坐“长崎丸”号轮船抵达。

Tachikawa.
